seo.metaTitle: Create Gradient PNG - Free Linear Gradient Generator
seo.metaDescription: Generate a linear gradient PNG in your browser: two colors, a direction and any canvas size. Free, no upload, no signup, downloads instantly.
seo.longDescription: Create gradient PNG draws a linear gradient — a smooth transition from one color to another along a straight line — and encodes it as a PNG of any size. Choose the start and end colors, set the angle, and the canvas is filled with the blend in your browser. There is no upload because there is no source file: the gradient is computed pixel by pixel on your device. Gradients are the background of most landing pages, slide decks and app shells, and exporting one as an image gives a background that does not depend on CSS support at all.
facts: Computed entirely in your browser: no upload, no server, no signup.
Two colors, an angle in degrees and any canvas size, with presets.
Per-pixel floating-point blend — smooth transitions stay smooth.
Free with no daily limit, no watermark and no account, also for commercial use.
howTo: Set the canvas size in pixels, or pick a preset.
Choose the color the gradient starts from and the color it ends at.
Set the angle: 0 runs left to right, 90 runs bottom to top.
Download the gradient as a PNG from the Download button.

faq.a: It is the direction of the gradient line in degrees. At 0 the first color is on the left and the last on the right; at 90 the first color is at the bottom; 180 is right to left and 270 top to bottom.

faq.q: Can I get a radial gradient instead?
faq.a: Not on this page - it draws linear gradients. For a radial fade, create a transparent canvas, run the remove-background tool against one edge, and raise the tolerance until the fade covers the image.

The blend is computed per pixel in floating point and encoded with a high bit depth, so smooth transitions stay smooth. Very wide low-contrast gradients can still show faint steps after the PNG is quantized, which is a property of the format, not of the generator.

faq.q: Is this free to use in commercial work?
faq.a: Yes. There is no signup, no watermark and no daily limit, no file is uploaded, and the project is open source.
